items.source_excerpt: Elon Musk and over 158,000 supporters have signed an open letter urging Nvidia's board to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang, who stepped down amid scandal involving extramarital affairs. Allegations surfaced that Huang misled company executives about the nature of one relationship, raising concerns over ties to Chinese intelligence. As Nvidia faces mounting pressure and a significant drop in stock value, Huang publicly apologized for his actions.
